Title: Why does your lower back feel stiffer after a long commute? 3 foods that make it worse

Description:
If your lower back feels stiffer after a long commute than after an actual workout, it's probably not just the sitting - a few common foods can make that stiffness worse.

Salty snacks, alcohol, and sugary treats are three of the most common culprits, and each one has an easy swap that still lets you enjoy your day.

Watch to find out why, and what to reach for instead.
